summary: BROGRESSIVE (imported repo) — backend + frontend testing in new preview env. Extended backend_test.py to 51 tests (all PASS) with new coverage for stubbed Google OAuth (503), stubbed Email/Forgot-password (generic 200), /auth/register + short-password 400, and client-A→client-B RBAC 403. Frontend Playwright verified the bug-fix on /login register form: fields (register-name-input, login-email-input, login-password-input) accept sequential typing without losing focus/value, hint 'Minimal 8 karakter' is present, submit 'Buat Akun' creates account and redirects to /app. Google button hidden, 'Lupa password?' link hidden. Mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow. Landing page renders normally.

issues: Client-side visible error for password <8 char was not detected by generic .error/[role=alert] selector — validation likely surfaced as a toast (Sonner) which auto-dismisses. Server correctly returns 400 with 'Password minimal 8 karakter'. Consider inline error text under the password field for stronger a11y (aria-describedby).
Still logs a 401 from /api/auth/me on /login before user authenticates — cosmetic, expected in current AuthContext design (documented in iteration_1).

action_items: (Optional) Surface password<8 validation as inline text under the password input in addition to toast for better UX/a11y.
(Optional, from prior iteration) Gate initial /api/auth/me call in AuthContext on public routes to silence 401 noise.
(Cleanup) backend/.env has CORS_ORIGINS="*" that is unused because CORSMiddleware uses FRONTEND_URL — remove to reduce confusion.

GOOGLE_AUTH_ENABLED / EMAIL_ENABLED guards are correctly implemented: /auth/google-session → 503, /auth/forgot-password → generic 200 no-op. Verified via tests.
/auth/register password<8 returns 400 with clear detail 'Password minimal 8 karakter'. Good.
RBAC verified: authenticated client cannot access another client's /clients/{id}/overview (403); own overview 200.
Admin seed at startup with tiofansha@gmail.com / Brogressive#2026 confirmed working.
Login form fix (type=button on tabs, autoComplete, autoFocus, hint text) fully resolves the reported form-entry bug — verified by scripted typing and successful register→/app redirect.
